executiveAssessment.text: Bethesda Marriott currently shows AI Consideration of 42.1% and Scenario Presence of 81.0%, with Reality Coverage at null. Strongest governed signal: Often placed near the top when AI ranks hotels. Primary constraint: Not appearing consistently in AI answers. No prior published run is available in the trend series for this review. Independent Positioning shows #1 of 4 with Portfolio AI Presence 42.1%. Independent Positioning is weak as well, so the Core and portfolio reads point in the same direction. Overall Core performance remains weak; gaps are broad across consideration, scenario coverage, and Independent Positioning. Management should prioritize correcting clear visibility and reality gaps, then address the competitors that most often appear when the property is absent.

positiveSignal.title: Positive Signal
positiveSignal.body: Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, Bethesda Marriott appeared in the Top 3 76.7% of the time. This shows how prominently the hotel is positioned when AI includes it.

secondaryCallout.title: Performance Risk
secondaryCallout.body: The hotel appeared in at least one AI answer for 81% of the traveler needs we tested, but across all individual AI answers it appeared 42.1% of the time. In practical terms, AI recognizes the hotel as relevant for many types of trips, but a traveler will not consistently see it among the hotel options surfaced.

managementPriority.title: Management Priority
managementPriority.body: Prioritize correcting high-severity reality gaps and the information conditions behind displacement by Hyatt Regency Bethesda.
